title: Astrology Forecast for July 8, 2026: Mercury to Move into Libra
summary: Mercury is set to move into the sign of Libra on July 8, 2026, which may have implications for business and financial matters. Some astrologers believe that this shift could bring economic relief to individuals with certain zodiac signs. Meanwhile, there are indications that international projects may be nearing completion.
